nodes.short_description: Course anti-gravité en VR où tu pilotes avec ton corps. Penche-toi dans chaque virage, tire vers l'arrière pour freiner, pousse vers l'avant pour le boost. Cours après le tour parfait sur des circuits au néon. Pas de joystick, juste toi et le chrono.

Corridas antigravidade em RV onde conduzes com o corpo. Inclina-te em cada curva, puxa para trás para travar, empurra para a frente para o boost. Persegue a volta perfeita em pistas iluminadas com néon. Sem joysticks, só tu contra o relógio.

nodes.long_description:
# Are you ready for HoverLap?
VR arcade racing where your body is the controller. Tear through neon-lit tracks, chasing the perfect lap. Beat the clock to unlock what's next, every second counts. No thumbsticks, pure speed.
{1335957645320053}

# Lean to steer
Your body is the controller. Lean into the turn and the craft leans with you. No thumbstick between you and the race, just instinct, momentum, and the nerve to hold your line.
{1739642140397299}

# Brake and boost 
Pull back to brake, push forward to boost. Physical, intuitive, and once it clicks you won't want to race any other way.

{1336316541430836}

# Bronze to Gold 
Three tiers per track: Bronze, Silver, Gold. Hit Bronze to unlock what's next. Chase Gold to prove you've mastered it. Credits buy new vehicles. No loot boxes, no random drops, just you against the clock.
{3507804969375230}

# Climb the ranks 
Global leaderboards track every run. See where you stand. Then go faster.

{1941168226596347}

# Join our Discord
https://discord.gg/HEDxtQ3dVn
nodes.short_description: VR anti-gravity racing where you steer with your body. Lean into every turn, pull back to brake, push forward to boost. Chase the perfect lap across neon-lit tracks. No thumbsticks, just you against the clock.

Carreras antigravedad en RV donde conduces con el cuerpo. Inclínate en cada curva, tira hacia atrás para frenar, empuja hacia delante para el boost. Persigue la vuelta perfecta en circuitos de neón. Sin joysticks, solo tú contra el reloj.
Antigravitations-Rennen in VR, bei dem du mit deinem Körper steuerst. Neige dich in jede Kurve, zieh zurück zum Bremsen, drück nach vorne für den Boost.
